rundown: Rockets beat Pacers 119-104 at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IN in front of 17,274. Rockets led 62-46 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Rockets won it 39-28.
Leading the way — Rockets: Kevin Durant 21 pts; Fred VanVleet 6 ast; Amen Thompson 9 reb. Pacers: Pascal Siakam 24 pts; T.J. McConnell 5 ast; Braden Smith 5 reb.
Where Rockets won it: they shot 54% from three to 29%, won the boards 46-35 and had 30 assists to 25.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Rockets closed as 7.5-point favorites and covered by 7.5; the total closed at 224.5 and they combined for 223, under by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 18, 6:56 PM ET. It had Rockets 64% and Pacers 36%, projecting Rockets 114 – Pacers 109.8 (223.8 total, Rockets by 4.2).

Final: Rockets 119 – Pacers 104. Right winner: it had Rockets at 64%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Rockets came in with a 2% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (11-4, 117.8 scored and 109.5 allowed a game over 15 games), worth about 88 and 88 games of evidence. Projected to score 114, they scored 119 (+5 points, 4% over); projected to allow 109.8, they allowed 104 (−5.8 points, 5% under).

Pacers came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (5-9, 112.1 scored and 114.5 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 80 and 81 games of evidence. Projected to score 109.8, they scored 104 (−5.8 points, 5% under); projected to allow 114, they allowed 119 (+5 points, 4% over).

The bigger miss was Pacers' scoring (-5.8 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 223 against 223.8 projected (-0.8), about the 48th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Rockets by 15 against Rockets by 4.2 projected, about the 18th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
IND ML (+262) at +262: the algo gave it 27% vs 27% fair (+0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 27%). HOU ML (-326) at -326: the algo gave it 73% vs 73% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 73%). IND +8.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+1.4 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing +7.5 by 1. HOU -8.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.4 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the closing -7.5 by 1. OVER 225.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 224.5 by 1. UNDER 225.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 224.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Pacers +8.5 → +7.5; total 225.5 → 224.5. The total moved toward the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 66% of bets on Rockets, 63% of the money — Rockets covered; total: 84% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 94% of bets on Rockets, 94% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Rockets, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.992 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.4 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 104 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.996 and gives home teams +0.3 points. Team corrections so far: Rockets attack ×0.998, defense ×1.008 (8 games); Pacers attack ×1.002, defense ×0.990 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
